version.description: Schema metadata version per ADR-0016. Project invariant: all rdd-workflow schemas keep version.const='v1' (schema system version, NOT contract version). Contract version lives in properties.version.const and is 2 for populate-state v2.

title: Populate State (move-populate-roadmap-into-rdd-arch, contract v2)
description: Schema for .rddf/state/.populate-state.json — incremental populate-roadmap state. Tracks ADR file hashes, a symbol->ADR reverse index, and per-phase fragment generation timestamps so populate-roadmap-from-arch can decide between full regeneration and incremental updates. v2 payloads with properties.version=1 are rejected (fail-loud) so v1.1 users get a clear error.

version.description: Contract version. Exactly 2 — v1 state files (from v1.1 populate-roadmap) are rejected with a clear error.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this state file was last written.

codebase_commit.description: Git commit SHA (short or full) of the codebase at generation time.

codegraph_fingerprint.description: Optional fingerprint of the codegraph index used for the reverse index. Null when codegraph was unavailable.

adrs.description: Map of ADR id -> ADR metadata snapshot used for change detection.

file_path.description: Path to the ADR file relative to project root.

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest (64 lowercase hex chars) of the ADR file content.

status.description: ADR lifecycle status (e.g. '已采纳', '已弃用').

phase.description: Roadmap phase this ADR belongs to, if known.

category.description: Roadmap category within the phase, if known.

reverse_index.description: symbol -> [adr_id, ...] mapping (populated by adr scan / codegraph).

phases.description: Map of phase id -> fragment generation metadata.

fragment_path.description: Path to the phase fragment file (e.g. '.rddf/roadmap/phases/phase-1.md').

last_generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this fragment was last (re)generated.
